name: DeLaurenti Classic Chocolate Chip Cookie
description: A lot has been said about this cookie. We think it's the best around. It's won awards and been enjoyed by thousands of our important customers. Buy one, you won't be disappointed.

name: DeLaurenti Chocolate Hazelnut Cookie
description: The fans of this cookie are an elite group. We love them, and we love this cookie. Yes, you can pretend that you are only going to eat half and save the rest for after dinner. There's no judgement here, and there are plenty of roasted hazelnuts for protein.

name: DeLaurenti Peanutbutter Cookie
description: Our most underrated cookie. A cafe classic. Rich peanut butter with the subtle crunch of flaky sea salt on top...enough said.

name: Torres Black Truffle Chips, 40g
description: Potatoes..salt...black truffle...portable snack size. Need we say more?

name: Torres Extra Virgin Olive Oil Chips, 40g
description: These might be the perfect food. Potatoes perfectly fried in extra virgin olive oil with just enough salt. Simple? Yes. Simply awesome? Also yes.

name: Torres Pimenton Chips, 50g
description: Light & crisp chips, fried in extra virgin olive oil with a dusting of smoky Spanish paprika. Great with a sandwich. Great for tapas!

name: Torres Sea Salt Chips, 50g
description: The classic. Light & crisp with nothing artificial. These are the chips that Lays wishes they could be.
